title: fails the step when the image or the copy is refused, after running both, and hands the spec no app
why: The check's exit status dropped: a Release whose app is not notarised is recorded as one that is, and the gate goes on to test it.

title: holds a tag that carries the release config to the Developer ID checks, image first then the copy
why: The Developer ID checks never reached: a signed Release is recorded on the strength of the ad-hoc check, which any valid signature passes.
